# Instructions

In this task, you are presented with a scenario, a question, and multiple choices. 
Carefully analyze the scenario and take the perspective of the individual involved.
Then, select the option that best reflects their perspective or emotional response.

# Output

Provide only one single correct answer to this question.  Do not provide any additional information or explanations. The response should be in the following JSON format:

```json
    {
    "answer_q1": "<Respond to the Question 1 with the corresponding letter numbering>",
"answer_q2": "<Respond to the Question 2 with the corresponding letter numbering>"

    }
``` 
    

## Scenario
Instead of grading our papers, my professor likes to write the number of mistakes as our assignment score. After submitting our final project last week, I wasn't sure if I did well. Today, I finally got my assignment breakdown and saw 1 out of 10 on it.

## Question 1
What emotion(s) would I ultimately feel in this situation?

## Choices for Question 1
A) Disgust
B) Disapproval
C) Delight
D) Sadness
E) Hopeless
F) Embarrassment

## Question 2
Why would I feel these emotions in this situation?

## Choices for Question 2
A) I only made one mistake in my final project despite thinking I didn't do well
B) I did very bad in the exam since I only got one question correct
C) I got the lowest mark in class
D) I got the highest mark in class
